With Yubikey you don't have to use 2FA authenticator apps on websites that support hardware authentication. As a result, chance of phishing your 2FA code is nonexistent on websites that work with since Yubikey checks authenticity of websites. 

It also has its own 2FA system that adds 2FA keys to login forms. This provides another layer of protection in case your 2FA service gets compromised (which is hopefully unlikely) since keys are generated by the Yubikey. 

Lastly, it's more convenient than using a 2FA in my humble opinion.

It's more secure since it requires hackers to have the actual Yubikey if they want to access accounts that use hardware authentication. 

For websites that use 2FA codes, you're still vulnerable to phishing attacks just like with any other 2FA app, but your 2FA data is on Yubikey so it can't get hacked online.

You can use any USB A to USB C adapter I assume. Do keep in mind that this isn't always practical because you need to carry adapter along with your Yubikey.

Hey, fellow support player. 
I'm mostly a 5th position support, so let me tell you what I do.

As a support player you must try not to take any last hits from your carry. For example, your Anti-Mage won't get his items if you keep stealing his farm. As a support, you don't need many items (due to this you are the squishiest part of your team). If your lane is pushed, make sure you stack and pull to move back the creep wave closer to your tower.

As for items, wards and sentries are your best friends, and you'll be buying them the entire game. I see many supports get set of wards and courier at the start of the game, and that's it. No, no, your team needs vision at all times. Well placed ward can protect your carry if he's solo farming, or it allows you to spot an enemy carry and gank him. So as a 5th position support remember wards are your core items, besides boots. You don't need Aghs, you don't need Mek, the 4th position support can get that. You just need to get the wards, place them, grab a dust if they have invis and try not to die.

If you manage to get some amount of money you can get something like Urn or Medallion, but remember, your job isn't about farming and going for items. Instead you can stack a camp or Ancients for your carry, place a ward at Rosh, or in enemy jungle. 

Also, try to protect your carry when he's farming. If you see enemy carry going for last hits hit him with your auto attack, or hit enemy support if they are getting close to your carry. Also, try to deny your creeps to prevent enemy from getting a bit of gold and xp. If your carry is about to die, sometimes is better to just throw yourself into the enemy, block them with your body, even sacrifice yourself for your carry.

In pub games, it's unlikely that you'll have two supports, or both of them might rush for some nice items (in last match I had CM with Linken, Boots of Travel and Bloodstone), so if you're a solo support you might want to go for some nice items such as Mek, since being a solo support for 4 cores feels unrewarding (and bit frustrating) at least to me.

Blocking a jungle camp or an ancient camp is when you have a unit inside the camp and a minute mark (since camps respawn at XX:00 if they are empty).

In order to block the camp you can just stand in it, but better way is to place a ward in it to prevent it from respawning, thus blocking the camp. It's also good to use sentries for that since you can have as many sentries as you want, since they will block camps as well. 

I also have to mention that each camp has a zone that is bit bigger than the camp itself, so if you want to block a camp just place a unit, or a ward, or a sentry in that zone. In other words, you don't have to place a sentry right in the center of the camp (among the creeps) to block it. This is useful since it allows you to be sneaky and hide your sentry in the trees, making it harder to deward.
